text:
Hi, posting anonymously as it is for me & my ex.
We renewed his b1 for the 3rd year in May and broke up a month ago (we’re not likely to get back together). We currently still live together until we know what to do with his visa.

He’s from Ireland, came to Israel with a masters in Chemistry, and he absolutely wants to stay. He made amazing friends here, loves his job, and loves this country like he’s a real Israeli. His center of life is definitely here. We don’t have kids (besides our 2 cats). 

Unfortunately, his job can’t sponsor him, as it requires a very heavy salary jump (PIBA requirements). We’d like to apply for a humanitarian visa, but i’d like to hear some other options.

Has anyone heard of someone who went through the process, broke up, and managed to have the non-Israeli partner stay in the country?
